question: What is EduFlow?
answer: EduFlow is an AI-powered corporate learning management system that helps companies deliver personalised training to their employees. It combines adaptive learning paths with real-time progress tracking and manager dashboards so L&D teams can run their entire training programme from a single platform. Over 1200 companies already trust EduFlow to train their teams faster and more effectively than traditional LMS solutions.

question: What are the key features of EduFlow?
answer: EduFlow offers six core features. First is Personalised Learning Paths where AI adapts content to each employee based on their role and skill gaps. Second is Progress Analytics with real-time dashboards for managers and HR leaders. Third is a 500+ Course Library with off-the-shelf content across business and tech and compliance topics. Fourth is 40+ Integrations including native connections to Slack and BambooHR and Workday and Salesforce. Fifth is Mobile Learning where employees can learn on any device even offline with progress syncing when they reconnect. Sixth is Compliance Tracking with automated certification management and audit-ready reports for regulated industries.

question: How much does EduFlow cost?
answer: EduFlow offers three pricing plans. The Starter plan costs 299 dollars per month or 239 dollars per month billed annually and supports up to 50 users with access to the core course library of 200+ courses and basic progress tracking and email support and mobile app access and CSV reporting. The Growth plan costs 799 dollars per month or 639 dollars per month billed annually and supports up to 200 users with everything in Starter plus the full analytics dashboard and 40+ integrations including Slack and HRIS and CRM and custom learning paths and priority support and manager dashboards. The Enterprise plan has custom pricing for unlimited users and includes everything in Growth plus custom content creation and a dedicated Customer Success Manager and SSO and advanced security and SLA guarantee and custom integrations. All plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

question: How does EduFlow compare to LinkedIn Learning?
answer: LinkedIn Learning is excellent for individual skill-building but EduFlow is built specifically for companies. EduFlow offers manager dashboards that give team leads full visibility into their team's progress. It also provides compliance certification tracking which LinkedIn Learning does not have. EduFlow includes team-level analytics so you can see skill gaps across departments. It supports custom content uploads including your own SCORM files and videos. EduFlow has native HRIS integrations with tools like BambooHR Workday and ADP that LinkedIn Learning cannot match. Finally EduFlow provides dedicated onboarding support with every plan.

question: How long does it take to set up EduFlow?
answer: Most teams are fully set up within one business day. The setup process has three simple steps. Step one is to upload your content by dragging in existing training materials or SCORM files or videos or choose from the 500+ course library. Step two is to assign to your team by building learning paths by role or department or individual and setting deadlines and reminders automatically. Step three is to track everything by seeing completion rates and quiz scores and skill gaps in one real-time dashboard and exporting for audits in one click. No IT team is required and there is no six-month implementation process. The average time to first course assignment is under 4 hours. EduFlow handles data migration and provides a dedicated onboarding specialist at no extra cost.

question: What integrations does EduFlow support?
answer: EduFlow supports over 40 native integrations across several categories. For HRIS and HR tools it integrates with BambooHR and Workday and ADP and Gusto. For communication tools it connects to Slack and Microsoft Teams. For CRM systems it works with Salesforce and HubSpot. For identity management it supports SSO through Okta and Azure AD. For content it handles SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 imports. Full REST API access is available on Growth and Enterprise plans for building custom integrations. The Salesforce integration alone has been reported to save customers 6 hours per week on average.

question: Is EduFlow secure?
answer: Yes EduFlow takes security very seriously. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 and TLS 1.3 respectively. EduFlow is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Enterprise customers get SSO through SAML 2.0 and OIDC with support for Okta Azure AD and Google Workspace. Role-based access control ensures employees only see their assigned content while managers see their team's progress and admins have full organisational visibility. EduFlow performs annual third-party penetration tests and maintains a 99.9% uptime SLA on Enterprise plans.

question: Can employees learn on mobile devices?
answer: Yes EduFlow has a fully native mobile app for both iOS and Android. Employees can complete courses watch videos take quizzes and track their progress from any device. The app supports offline learning so employees can download courses and complete them without internet access. Progress automatically syncs when they reconnect. Push notifications remind employees about upcoming deadlines and new course assignments. The mobile experience is identical to desktop with no features missing. Over 40 percent of EduFlow learning happens on mobile devices according to their usage analytics.

question: What kind of analytics does EduFlow provide?
answer: EduFlow provides comprehensive analytics at four levels. At the individual level managers can see each employee's completion rates and quiz scores and time spent and skill gap analysis. At the team level department heads can compare performance across their direct reports and identify training bottlenecks. At the organisation level HR and L&D leaders get dashboards showing overall completion rates and most popular courses and certification compliance status and learning engagement trends over time. At the content level course creators can see which modules have the highest completion and engagement and where learners drop off. All reports can be exported as CSV or PDF for audit purposes. The Growth and Enterprise plans include advanced analytics with custom report builders.

question: Does EduFlow support compliance training?
answer: Yes EduFlow has a dedicated compliance tracking module that is used by companies in healthcare finance manufacturing and other regulated industries. The system automatically assigns required compliance courses based on employee role and location. It tracks certification expiration dates and sends reminder notifications 30 and 14 and 7 days before expiry. Managers get a compliance dashboard showing who is certified and who is overdue and who is at risk. EduFlow generates audit-ready reports that can be exported with one click for regulatory submissions. The platform supports mandatory re-certification workflows and prevents employees from working on certain tasks until their training is complete.

question: Can we upload our own training content?
answer: Yes EduFlow supports multiple content formats for custom uploads. You can upload SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 packages for interactive e-learning modules. Video is supported in MP4 format and you can also embed Vimeo and YouTube videos directly. Documents can be uploaded as PDF or PowerPoint or Google Slides. Additionally you can create native quizzes and assessments directly in the platform. Content can be organised into learning paths and assigned to individuals or groups or entire departments. You upload once and assign to any team or individual. EduFlow also provides a content authoring tool on Enterprise plans for creating interactive modules from scratch.

question: How do I get started with a free trial?
answer: Getting started with EduFlow is simple and takes less than 5 minutes. Visit the EduFlow website and click Start Free Trial. Enter your work email and create a password. No credit card is required. You will get immediate access to the full Growth plan features for 14 days. During your trial you can upload your own content or explore the 500+ course library. You can invite up to 10 team members to test the platform together. A dedicated onboarding specialist will reach out within 24 hours to help you set up. At the end of your trial you can choose to continue on any plan or cancel with no obligation. Setup typically takes one afternoon.

question: Does EduFlow offer an API for custom integrations?
answer: Yes EduFlow provides a comprehensive REST API available on Growth and Enterprise plans. The API supports full CRUD operations on users and courses and learning paths and progress data and certificates and reports. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with API key and secret pairs. The API supports webhooks for real-time event notifications such as course completion or certification expiry. Rate limits are 1000 requests per minute on Growth and 5000 requests per minute on Enterprise. Comprehensive API documentation with code examples in Python JavaScript and cURL is available at docs.eduflow.com/api. A sandbox environment is provided for testing integrations before going live.
